hero.pill: For students in Telangana · Free to use
hero.title: Find the scholarships you may qualify for. See the exact route to claim them.
hero.teluguLine: మీ పరిస్థితిని చెప్పండి. మేము దారి చూపిస్తాము.
hero.description: Tell Claimo your situation in your own words, in Telugu or English. It shows which schemes you are likely eligible for, which rule each match is based on, which documents to get first, and how to apply.
hero.note: No login needed. We never ask for Aadhaar or any ID number.

sampleCard.ariaLabel: Sample scholarship matches card showing likely eligible, possibly, and not likely tiers
sampleCard.rule2: Family income is within [limit in official clause]
sampleCard.verified: Source verified: [date] · Double-checked by a second person
sampleCard.possiblyTitle: Income certificate period not confirmed yet. Choose per month or per year.
sampleCard.notLikelyTitle: Blocked by the income rule. It would change if your certified income is within the limit.
sampleCard.footer: Likely eligible, not guaranteed. The official office makes the final decision.

trustStrip.item2: No Aadhaar or ID numbers collected
trustStrip.item3: Official source and verified date on every scheme
trustStrip.item4: Official fees shown, so no one overcharges you

problem.title: Why eligible students still miss out
problem.lead: It is rarely because they did not try. The route is confusing, and some people pay middlemen for help that should be free.

scattered.title: Information is scattered
scattered.desc: Notices and portals each tell part of the story.

rules.title: Rules are hard to read
rules.desc: Legal wording and limits are hard to apply to your own family.

documents.title: The document list is unclear
documents.desc: One certificate often needs another first, and the order matters.

middlemen.title: Middlemen fill the gap
middlemen.desc: People pay for help that the official process does not charge for.

how.title: How Claimo works
how.lead: Four steps from your story to a clear plan.

step1.title: Tell your story
step1.desc: Type or speak in Telugu or English. No long forms.

step2.title: Confirm what we understood
step2.desc: Check the facts and correct anything. You always choose per month or per year for income.

step3.title: See your matches and why
step3.desc: Every result shows the rule it is based on, from the official source.

step4.title: Follow the route
step4.desc: Get documents in the right order, apply on the official site, and track deadlines.

features.title: Built for trust, not just a list
features.lead: Claimo explains its reasoning, so you can check it against the official source.

confirmation.title: Safe confirmation card
confirmation.desc: The AI only reads your story. You confirm every fact before any matching happens.

tiers.title: Three clear tiers
tiers.desc: Likely eligible, possibly (confirm one thing), or not likely, with the reason for each.

nearMiss.title: Near-miss explanations
nearMiss.desc: If you just miss a rule, we show what blocked you and what would change the result.

docOrder.title: Documents in the right order
docOrder.desc: 'Get this first' guidance, plus a one-page Visit Plan you can print.

feeShield.title: Fee Shield
feeShield.desc: See the official cost of each step and the grievance route if anyone asks for more.

telugu.title: Listen in Telugu
telugu.desc: The main journey can be read aloud, with big buttons that work on a basic phone.

promises.title: What Claimo will never do
promises.lead: Honesty matters more than looking impressive.

guarantee.title: Promise you will get it
guarantee.desc: Results say 'likely'. The official office makes the final decision.

aadhaar.title: Ask for Aadhaar or ID numbers
aadhaar.desc: Checklists say 'bring this document', never 'type its number'.

status.title: Pretend to see your status
status.desc: Tracking is what you report. Always check the official portal.

guess.title: Guess missing facts
guess.desc: If a scheme does not publish something, we say 'Not published by the scheme'.

cta.title: Ready to find your route?
cta.text: It takes about two minutes. No login, and your story is not saved on our server.

footer.text: Claimo is a guide, not a government service, and it does not submit applications. Scheme details come from official sources and show their last-verified date. Demo screens use sample profiles only. Built for the Codebenders ACE Builders' Hackathon 2026.
